# The 44 Live Music Bar

> The 44 is a live music bar in Glendale, Arizona (West Valley, Phoenix metro). Live music seven nights a week, a late-night kitchen, and the Glendale home base for DartyForLife's Tuesday college bar nights. Located at 4494 W Peoria Ave, five minutes from Glendale Community College and a short drive from ASU West and GCU.

## Key facts
- Name: The 44 Live Music Bar
- Address: 4494 W Peoria Ave, Glendale, AZ 85302
- Phone: (623) 842-1053
- Hours: 1:00 PM to 2:00 AM daily
- College nights: run by DartyForLife (https://dartyforlife.com/), not by The 44's own box office. Tuesdays at The 44 in Glendale, doors 9PM. Thursdays at The Rack, 3636 N Scottsdale Rd, Old Town Scottsdale, Ages 21 & over.
- Event booking contact: Benjamin Millo, Booking@the44.live
- Price range: budget-friendly
- Best known for: live music, late-night food, Tuesday college bar nights

## Pages
- [Home](https://the44.live/): about The 44, live music, food and ordering
- [College Nights](https://the44.live/college-night.html): Tuesdays at The 44 and Thursdays at The Rack, both run by DartyForLife
- [Live Music & Events](https://the44.live/events.html): full upcoming show calendar, straight from the box office
- [Menu](https://the44.live/menu.html): food menu and ordering (Toast, Uber Eats, DoorDash, Grubhub)
- [Book an Event](https://the44.live/book.html): private events, corporate, and talent booking
